info.title: saci
info.description: saci - Software Agent for Continuous Improvement: autonomous triager, developer, reviewer and tester agents for GitHub repositories, powered by Claude Code.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: saci 0.61.0 - Software Agent for Continuous Improvement. Autonomous triager, developer, reviewer and tester agents for GitHub repositories, powered by Claude Code. 'saci shell' opens an interactive shell.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Also print what saci does behind the scenes: every git, gh and claude process with its duration and exit code (always in the log file). [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine-readable output: one JSON object per line (events log, item, result, error, done). For scripts and language models. [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-limits
options.description: Skip the 5-hour and 7-day subscription window limits for this run (usage.maxFiveHourPercent / maxSevenDayPercent). The pause, the active hours and Claude's own refusals still apply. [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: After the command, stay in the interactive shell instead of returning to the system prompt: the next commands are typed without the 'saci' prefix. [default: False]

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Run an agent profile defined in the configuration (customProfiles).

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: Work on exactly these issues, even if the profile handled them before: a number, a comma-separated list (5241,5244) or a range (5244-5248). Repeatable.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of issues to handle in this run: 1 when not given, 0 for no limit.

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many items to work on at the same time. Defaults to 'maxParallel' of the configuration (1).

options.name: --force
options.description: Include issues the profile already handled. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Run this many passes in a row; every pass takes the next items (--max each). Stops early when a pass finds nothing to do. Default 1. [default: 1]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of a profile defined in 'customProfiles' of the configuration.

commands.name: bug
commands.description: Bugs saci found in itself that could not be filed in the saci repository yet.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the bug reports waiting in the local outbox.

commands.name: submit
commands.description: File the waiting bug reports in the saci repository.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove the worktrees of work that is finished: merged or closed pull requests and closed issues.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to clean (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder, or every registered repository outside a clone.

options.name: --all
options.description: Remove every saci worktree of the repository, not only the ones of finished work. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

commands.name: config
commands.description: Inspect the saci configuration.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Print the location of the configuration file.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print the effective configuration, including defaults.

commands.name: develop
commands.description: Developer: first take care of its open pull requests (review comments, failing checks, conflicts), then implement triaged issues and open a pull request for each.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: Work on exactly these issues, skipping the review-feedback pass: a number, a comma-separated list (5241,5244) or a range (5244-5248). Repeatable.

options.name: --pr
options.description: Only take care of these pull requests: review feedback, comments, failing checks, conflicts: a number, a comma-separated list (9440,9444) or a range (9440-9444). Repeatable.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of new issues to handle in this run: 1 when not given, 0 for no limit.

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many items to work on at the same time. Defaults to 'maxParallel' of the configuration (1).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Run this many passes in a row; every pass takes the next items (--max each). Stops early when a pass finds nothing to do. Default 1. [default: 1]

options.name: --fill-window
options.description: You are done with Claude until the 5-hour window resets: raise the 5-hour limit to usage.fillWindowPercent (95%) for this run and keep running passes until the window is nearly used up, resets, or nothing is left to do. The 7-day limit still applies. [default: False]

options.name: --fill-week
options.description: You are done with Claude for the week: raise both limits to usage.fillWindowPercent / usage.fillWeekPercent (95%), and when the 5-hour window is used up sleep until it resets and continue, until the 7-day window is nearly used up or resets. With nothing to do it waits usage.fillIdleWait and looks again. [default: False]

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Print saci's documentation (Markdown) for a person or a language model: overview, commands, config, workflow, json, operator, or all.

arguments.name: TOPIC
arguments.description: One of overview, commands, config, workflow, json, operator, all. Defaults to overview. [default: overview]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that git, gh and claude are available and the configuration is usable.

commands.name: folders
commands.description: The folders saci was used in, most recent first. Their numbers work with 'saci spawn <n>' and 'cd <n>' in the shell.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Get a repository ready for saci: register this clone, let Claude write its shared configuration (.saci/config.json) from the code and the issues and open a pull request with it, and write a persona per profile. Creates the user configuration first when it is missing.

options.name: --force
options.description: Write the repository configuration and the personas again even if they already exist. [default: False]

options.name: --no-repo
options.description: Only create the user configuration; do not register or configure the current repository. [default: False]

options.name: --no-pr
options.description: Write .saci/config.json into this clone for you to commit, instead of a branch and a pull request. [default: False]

options.name: --no-personas
options.description: Do not write the personas (saci persona generate does it later). [default: False]

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Learner: study what people corrected in saci's merged or closed pull requests and add the lessons to the personas.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --pr
options.description: Study exactly this closed or merged pull request, even if it was studied before.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of pull requests to handle in this run: 1 when not given, 0 for no limit.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

commands.name: logs
commands.description: Show the saci log: everything the commands and agents did, including the git, gh and claude processes they ran.

options.name: --lines
options.description: How many of the last lines to show. [default: 50]

options.name: --follow
options.description: Keep printing new lines as saci writes them, until Ctrl+C. [default: False]

options.name: --date
options.description: Day to show (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to today.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve saci as an MCP server on stdin/stdout (for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other MCP clients): tools for status, usage, runs, dry runs, stats, logs, docs and any saci command.

commands.name: persona
commands.description: Manage the persona of each agent profile. Personas live in the repository (.saci/personas/<profile>.md) and are read from its default branch, so everyone running saci on it follows the same instructions.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Open a persona in your editor ($EDITOR, or the system default): the file in this clone, started from the shared one when the clone has none yet. Commit it when you are done.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

arguments.name: PROFILE
arguments.description: Agent profile: triager, developer, reviewer, tester or a custom profile.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Let Claude study the repository and write the personas, proposed as a pull request (an existing persona, in the repository or left on this machine by an older saci, is the starting point).

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace a persona the repository already has. [default: False]

options.name: --no-pr
options.description: Write the personas into this clone for you to commit, instead of a branch and a pull request. [default: False]

arguments.name: PROFILE
arguments.description: Agent profile: triager, developer, reviewer, tester or a custom profile (all when omitted).

commands.name: init
commands.description: Write the persona template into this clone (.saci/personas/) so you can fill it in by hand and commit it.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing persona with the template. [default: False]

arguments.name: PROFILE
arguments.description: Agent profile: triager, developer, reviewer, tester or a custom profile (all when omitted).

commands.name: path
commands.description: Print where the persona file lives in this clone.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

arguments.name: PROFILE
arguments.description: Agent profile: triager, developer, reviewer, tester or a custom profile.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print the persona an agent profile uses for the repository, and where it comes from.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

arguments.name: PROFILE
arguments.description: Agent profile: triager, developer, reviewer, tester or a custom profile.

commands.name: remote
commands.description: Start a Claude Code session with Remote Control that operates saci for you from claude.ai, from any device.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the session as shown in claude.ai. Defaults to 'saci on <machine>'.

commands.name: repo
commands.description: Register the repositories saci works on.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Register a clone. Another folder of an already registered repository joins the same entry and shares its personas.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Folder of a clone. Defaults to the current folder.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the registered repositories.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Unregister a repository. Its personas and session history are kept.

options.name: --path
options.description: Remove only this folder and keep the repository registered.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print the configuration of a repository.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Start an issue over: forget saci's developer session and worktree for it and put the ready label back, so the next run begins from scratch instead of resuming. Only for issues without a pull request.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: The issues to start over: a number, a comma-separated list (5241,5244) or a range (5244-5248). Repeatable.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

commands.name: review
commands.description: Reviewer: build, test, check the pull request solves its issue and try it in a browser; mark it ready for review when it passes.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --pr
options.description: Review exactly these pull requests, even if they were reviewed before: a number, a comma-separated list (9440,9444) or a range (9440-9444). Repeatable.

options.name: --force
options.description: With --pr: review a draft too, and start from scratch instead of resuming the previous review session. [default: False]

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of pull requests to handle in this run: 1 when not given, 0 for no limit.

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many items to work on at the same time. Defaults to 'maxParallel' of the configuration (1).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Run this many passes in a row; every pass takes the next items (--max each). Stops early when a pass finds nothing to do. Default 1. [default: 1]

options.name: --fill-window
options.description: You are done with Claude until the 5-hour window resets: raise the 5-hour limit to usage.fillWindowPercent (95%) for this run and keep running passes until the window is nearly used up, resets, or nothing is left to do. The 7-day limit still applies. [default: False]

options.name: --fill-week
options.description: You are done with Claude for the week: raise both limits to usage.fillWindowPercent / usage.fillWeekPercent (95%), and when the 5-hour window is used up sleep until it resets and continue, until the 7-day window is nearly used up or resets. With nothing to do it waits usage.fillIdleWait and looks again. [default: False]

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a full round on every registered repository: every enabled profile, then learning from finished pull requests and cleaning up worktrees.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Repeatable. Defaults to every registered repository.

options.name: --profiles
options.description: Comma-separated profiles to run, in order (triager, developer, reviewer, tester, learner or a custom profile). Defaults to a full round: every enabled profile, then learning and worktree cleanup.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Keep running: repeat after every interval until stopped with Ctrl+C. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Run this many passes in a row; every pass takes the next items (--max each). Stops early when a pass finds nothing to do. Default 1. [default: 1]

options.name: --fill-window
options.description: You are done with Claude until the 5-hour window resets: raise the 5-hour limit to usage.fillWindowPercent (95%) for this run and keep running passes until the window is nearly used up, resets, or nothing is left to do. The 7-day limit still applies. [default: False]

options.name: --fill-week
options.description: You are done with Claude for the week: raise both limits to usage.fillWindowPercent / usage.fillWeekPercent (95%), and when the 5-hour window is used up sleep until it resets and continue, until the 7-day window is nearly used up or resets. With nothing to do it waits usage.fillIdleWait and looks again. [default: False]

options.name: --interval
options.description: Pause between rounds with --watch, e.g. 30s, 10m, 1h. [default: 5m]

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of items per profile and repository to handle in this run: 1 when not given, 0 for no limit.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print a JSON Schema: of the two configuration files or of the --json output.

commands.name: session
commands.description: Inspect the Claude sessions saci started, and continue one yourself.

commands.name: flag
commands.description: Flag a session as not good enough: files an issue in the saci repository with your words, the session record and every run's prompt, answer, transcript and log, so saci can be improved from it.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: The latest session about this issue.

options.name: --pr
options.description: The latest session about this pull request.

options.name: --message
options.description: What was not good enough in this session: the verdict, the reasoning, the code, the comment, the cost...

arguments.name: SESSION
arguments.description: A session id (or its first characters), or 'issue N' / 'pr N' / '#N'.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the recorded Claude sessions, newest first.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Open a recorded session interactively in Claude Code, in the folder it ran in.

arguments.name: SESSION
arguments.description: Session id (or its first characters) as shown by 'saci session list'.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Everything saci kept locally about a session: the record, the worktree, every run with its folder (prompt, system prompt, answer, transcript, saci.log) and the end of each log. Point it at a session id, an issue or a pull request.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: Every session about this issue.

options.name: --pr
options.description: Every session about this pull request.

options.name: --tail
options.description: Lines of each run's saci.log to print. Default 20; 0 prints none. [default: 20]

arguments.name: SESSION
arguments.description: A session id (or its first characters), or 'issue N' / 'pr N' / '#N'.

commands.name: shell
commands.description: Start the interactive shell: type commands without the 'saci' prefix.

commands.name: solve
commands.description: Take one or more issues end to end: triage, then develop when the verdict allows it (naming the issue counts as approval), then review the pull request.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: The issues to take all the way: a number, a comma-separated list (5241,5244) or a range (5244-5248). Repeatable.

options.name: --retriage
options.description: Triage again even if saci already has a verdict on the issue. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

commands.name: spawn
commands.description: Open another saci in a new terminal window, in another folder (another repository or another clone).

arguments.name: FOLDER
arguments.description: A folder, or the number of a folder from 'saci folders'.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: The saci command to run there, e.g. 'run --watch'. Defaults to the interactive shell.

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Show what the agents cost: per repository, profile and day.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Only this repository (owner/name). Defaults to every registered repository.

options.name: --days
options.description: How many days back to report. [default: 7]

commands.name: status
commands.description: What the saci processes on this machine are working on right now, and whether they may start more.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Tell every saci process on this machine to finish its current item and stop its run (passes, rounds, --watch, --fill-window, --fill-week). Runs started afterwards are not affected.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Withdraw a stop request instead of making one. [default: False]

commands.name: test
commands.description: Tester: explore the application looking for problems (build, tests, the running app in a browser) and file what it finds as detailed issues.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --area
options.description: Part of the application to focus on. Repeatable. Defaults to the configured areas, or everything.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of issues to file in this run (0 explores without filing).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Run this many passes in a row; every pass takes the next items (--max each). Stops early when a pass finds nothing to do. Default 1. [default: 1]

options.name: --fill-window
options.description: You are done with Claude until the 5-hour window resets: raise the 5-hour limit to usage.fillWindowPercent (95%) for this run and keep running passes until the window is nearly used up, resets, or nothing is left to do. The 7-day limit still applies. [default: False]

options.name: --fill-week
options.description: You are done with Claude for the week: raise both limits to usage.fillWindowPercent / usage.fillWeekPercent (95%), and when the 5-hour window is used up sleep until it resets and continue, until the 7-day window is nearly used up or resets. With nothing to do it waits usage.fillIdleWait and looks again. [default: False]

commands.name: triage
commands.description: Triager: look for duplicates, check the issue is still a problem and reproducible, then label it or move it in the project.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository to work on (owner/name). Defaults to the repository of the current folder.

options.name: --issue
options.description: Triage exactly these issues, even if they were triaged before: a number, a comma-separated list (5241,5244) or a range (5244-5248). Repeatable.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Kind of issue to triage: an issue type or label such as Bug or Feature. Repeatable; 'all' triages every kind. Defaults to the configured kinds (Bug).

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of issues to handle in this run: 1 when not given, 0 for no limit.

options.name: --force
options.description: Include issues saci already triaged. [default: False]

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many items to work on at the same time. Defaults to 'maxParallel' of the configuration (1).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be done without starting Claude or changing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --times
options.description: Run this many passes in a row; every pass takes the next items (--max each). Stops early when a pass finds nothing to do. Default 1. [default: 1]

options.name: --fill-window
options.description: You are done with Claude until the 5-hour window resets: raise the 5-hour limit to usage.fillWindowPercent (95%) for this run and keep running passes until the window is nearly used up, resets, or nothing is left to do. The 7-day limit still applies. [default: False]

options.name: --fill-week
options.description: You are done with Claude for the week: raise both limits to usage.fillWindowPercent / usage.fillWeekPercent (95%), and when the 5-hour window is used up sleep until it resets and continue, until the 7-day window is nearly used up or resets. With nothing to do it waits usage.fillIdleWait and looks again. [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Install the latest saci version published on NuGet.org (or show whether one is available with --check).

options.name: --version
options.description: Install this version instead of the latest one, e.g. 0.42.0.

options.name: --check
options.description: Only show the installed and the latest version. [default: False]

commands.name: usage
commands.description: How much of the Claude subscription saci used, and pausing the agents so you keep it for yourself.

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Stop the agents from starting Claude sessions, so the subscription is yours.

arguments.name: DURATION
arguments.description: How long to pause, e.g. 2h or 30m. Without it saci stays paused until 'saci usage resume'.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Let the agents start Claude sessions again.

commands.name: web
commands.description: The web dashboard (also the GitHub webhook receiver and the background runner): start it in the background, stop it, see whether it runs.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start the web server in the background (web.port, 5080 by default) and print its address.

options.name: --foreground
options.description: Run the server in this terminal instead of in the background; Ctrl+C stops it. [default: False]

options.name: --dashboard-only
options.description: Do not run agents in this server: show the dashboard only. [default: False]

options.name: --port
options.description: Listen on this port instead of web.port.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Whether the web server runs, where, and since when.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the web server started with 'saci web start'.
